opportunities.name: Hotel proposal email with currency conversion
opportunities.description: Search Booking.com for a hotel in {city} for {check_in}–{check_out}, open a hotel, convert its price from EUR to {target_currency} on Xe, then email {recipient} with the hotel name, price and converted price, asking for approval to book.
steps: On Booking.com, click 'Enter destination', select all and type {city}
Open the date picker, go to the right month with 'Next month', then click the {check_in} and {check_out} dates
Click 'Search'
Open the chosen hotel result ({hotel_name}) and note its total price in EUR
On the Xe Currency Converter, set the amount to {price_eur} EUR
Set the target currency to {target_currency} (search the currency dropdown and pick the option)
Click 'Convert' and note the converted amount
In mail, compose: To={recipient}, Subject='Hotel for {city}, {check_in}-{check_out}'
Body='Hi {name}, proposed hotel: {hotel_name}, {price_eur} EUR (about {converted} {target_currency}). OK to book?'
Send the email (in the recording it was discarded)

instances.values: Frankfurt, Nov 17–20 2026, Vienna House by Wyndham Frankfurt South, 818 EUR → 915.34 USD, maria@example.com
Milan, Dec 1–4 2026, BB Hotels Aparthotel Visconti, 264 EUR → 46,794 JPY, kenji@example.com
Amsterdam, Jan 12–15 2027, Jan Luyken Amsterdam, 577 EUR → 487.44 GBP, aisha@example.com (interleaved with a Wikipedia lookup)

opportunities.name: City weather and strike news heads-up email
opportunities.description: Look up the 10-day forecast for {city} on the weather site, search BBC for '{city} strike' and open the latest article, then email {recipient} a heads-up with {day}'s forecast and the news headline.
steps: On the weather site, open location search and type {city}
Select the matching city suggestion
Click '10 Day' and note the high/low and conditions for {day}
On BBC, open the search (menu or 'Search BBC') and search for '{city} strike'
Open the top relevant result and note its headline and date
In mail, compose: To={recipient}, Subject='Heads-up: {city} on {day}'
Body='Hi {name}, {city} on {day}: {high}°/{low}°, {conditions}. Latest news: {headline} ({date}).'
Send the email (in the recording it was discarded)

opportunities.name: Visa requirement and holiday lookup note
opportunities.description: Look up the Wikipedia article 'Visa requirements for {nationality} citizens' to find the entry for {destination_country}, check the public holidays in {destination_country} for {month} on timeanddate.com, and save a summary note.
steps: On Wikipedia, search for 'Visa requirements for {nationality} citizens' and press Enter
Use Ctrl+F to find {destination_country} and note the visa requirement and allowed stay
On timeanddate.com, go to Holidays (dismiss the privacy dialog if it appears)
Search for or click {destination_country}, opening the full holiday list if needed
Note the holidays that fall in {month}
In Notes, click 'New note' and type '{nationality} traveler to {destination_country}: {visa_status}, allowed stay {stay}. Holidays in {month}: {holidays}'
Press Enter to save

instances.values: Indian → Japan, December (eVisa; no national holidays, Dec 31 bank holiday)
Brazilian → Canada, November (Visa required/eTA; Nov 11 Remembrance Day)
Nigerian → United Kingdom, May (Visa required; May 4 and May 25 bank holidays). Interleaved with the Amsterdam hotel workflow
